files.src/auth/session.ts:
import { signed } from './signature';
export function verifySession(token: string, expiresAt: number, now: number) { return signed(token) && expiresAt > now; }
files.src/auth/signature.ts: export function signed(token: string) { return token.startsWith('signed:'); }
files.src/billing/invoice.ts: export function invoiceTotal(values: number[]) { return values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0); }

facts.text: Checks the signed prefix and requires the supplied session expiry to be later than the supplied current time.
Checks whether the token starts with the signed prefix.
Delegates login validation to verifySession with the supplied token and times.
Computes an invoice total by summing values from zero.
